de: Nutzen Sie die DLR (Docklands Light Railway) für eine schnelle Verbindung ins Zentrum oder nach Canary Wharf.
Ein Spaziergang entlang des Themse-Pfads in Richtung Wapping bietet fantastische Ausblicke.
Am Limehouse Basin können Sie das Treiben der historischen Narrowboats beobachten.
Die historischen Pubs an der Narrow Street sind ideal, um die maritime Atmosphäre zu genießen.
Vermeiden Sie die Rushhour auf der Commercial Road, wenn Sie mit dem Bus fahren.
hu: Használd a DLR-t (Docklands Light Railway), ha gyorsan be akarsz jutni a belvárosba vagy a Canary Wharfra.
Sétálj egyet a Temze-parti ösvényen Wapping felé, a kilátás fantasztikus.
A Limehouse Basin kikötőjében szuperül megfigyelheted a hagyományos lakóhajókat (narrowboats).
Ülj be egy történelmi pubba a Narrow Streeten, hogy átéld az igazi tengerész-hangulatot.
Kerüld el a Commercial Roadot csúcsforgalomban, ha busszal utazol, mert hatalmas lehet a dugó.
ro: Folosiți DLR (Docklands Light Railway) pentru un acces rapid către centrul Londrei sau Canary Wharf.
O plimbare pe poteca de pe malul Tamisei (Thames Path) spre Wapping oferă priveliști excelente.
La Limehouse Basin puteți admira ambarcațiunile tradiționale (narrowboats) într-un cadru pitoresc.
Pub-urile istorice de pe Narrow Street sunt perfecte pentru a simți atmosfera maritimă.
Evitați Commercial Road în timpul orelor de vârf dacă călătoriți cu autobuzul.
en: Use the DLR (Docklands Light Railway) for quick access to central London or Canary Wharf.
A walk along the Thames Path towards Wapping offers excellent riverside views.
Limehouse Basin is a highly scenic spot to watch traditional narrowboats.
The historic pubs along Narrow Street are perfect for soaking up the area's maritime history.
Avoid Commercial Road during rush hour if traveling by bus due to heavy traffic.
